summary: PM6b: the plugins use the new hooks; the test plugin probes them
description:
Landed in:
- DevHub `fe604d0`: PM6: the test plugin exercises the Git hooks (IntegrationProbe: suggests DEV-7: from the branch, marks commits and branches, reports repository events in the status bar); roadmap: PM6 done (PM6b in DevHub-Plugins), PM7 next
- DevHub-Plugins `fe725b0`: PM6b: plugins use the Sdk's new hooks — Git raises repository events (GitRepositoryClient.OperationCompleted after a successful commit, fetch, pull or push, tested with real git; branch changes from each tab's status refresh) and offers them as IRepositoryEvents; Git's commit box shows other plugins' message suggestions (Suggested… / Use, never put in unasked) and its commit list and branch tree show their marks (IGitDecorator, tone badges, links http(s) only); GitHub offers IGitHubApi (GitHubApi.SendRawAsync: any REST call, answers passed through with ETag, next page and rate limit; only ever to api.github.com, tested); Templates uses the Sdk's TreeDragDrop. Builds against the Sdk with PM6a (DevHub release first)
